title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1+2 TEK KOMUNA E PARISIT, BEGA07
description_sq:

title_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS, BEGA07
